title: Curation decision record
description: One human-authored field-level assertion in the authoritative curation ledger.

subject_key.description: Non-null identity of the accession or accession-less subject.

accession.description: Unversioned GenBank accession, blank for accession-less subjects.

field_name.description: Registry field asserted by this decision.

reason.description: Human-entered rationale; blank means not recorded.

evidence_reference.description: Supporting PMID, URL, citation, or evidence key; blank means not recorded.

confirmed_by.description: Person or process that ratified the assertion; blank means not recorded.

source_artifact.description: Legacy or current registry artifact from which the decision was migrated.

effective_from.description: Inclusive release or date boundary; blank when not applicable.

effective_through.description: Inclusive release or date boundary; blank when not applicable.
